newsitem.title: USA: SmarTalk activates 348,106 cards in Q4.
newsitem.headline: SmarTalk activates 348,106 cards in Q4.

text.p: SmarTalk TeleServices Inc said Thursday that it activated 348,106 prepaid calling cards in the fourth quarter ended December 31, 1996, compared to 52,800 in the 1995 quarter and 262,872 in the third quarter.
The company said it activated 157,217 cards in January.
The company attributed the growth to continued retailer support and expanded in-store and promotional distribution.
Additionally, the company said it recently entered an agreement to provide prepaid long-distance calling cards to TravelMax, which makes and distributes travel-related products and services.
Los Angeles-based SmarTalk distributes prepaid calling cards and completed its initial public offering in October.
